headlines.summary: Anthony Scaramucci said that holding MSTR security for 4-5 years was going to be rewarding.

headlines.title: Strategy (MSTR) Stock May Still Look Undervalued Following The Binance Hack
headlines.summary: Strategy has swung from a sharp three year gain to heavy recent declines, which puts fresh focus on whether today’s share price lines up with the company’s book value. With the stock closing at US$121.07 and caught up in both crypto and tech volatility, investors are increasingly asking how much of that quote is really backed by the balance sheet. Over the past three years the share price has risen about 152.

headlines.title: Bitcoin at $73,600 Is Below Strategy’s Average Cost. How Long Can Saylor Go Without Selling?
headlines.summary: Strategy just told investors its cash cushion has grown sevenfold since May, yet Bitcoin now sits under what the company paid. Buybacks, bond put dates, and an MSCI ruling could quietly shrink the runway Saylor is counting on.

headlines.title: Strategy and Trump Media Bought the Bitcoin News: Is CPI the Trigger BTC Needs?
headlines.summary: In Bitcoin news today, two of the market’s best-known buyers added BTC, and the price did not budge. Strategy said on Monday that it bought 1,037 BTC last week. Hours later, Trump Media reported that it added a net 1,510 BTC, worth about $113 million, in the third quarter.

headlines.title: Strategy (MSTR) Is Building A Global Bitcoin Bank
headlines.summary: MicroStrategy (NasdaqGS:MSTR) outlined plans to become a global Bitcoin bank at a major fintech conference, as described by CEO Phong Le. Phong Le detailed efforts to link traditional finance services with decentralized Bitcoin holdings for institutional clients. The corporation aims to build full-scale institutional Bitcoin banking capabilities that integrate with existing financial infrastructure.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
